description: Classify a list of addresses in one call, returning a map keyed by address so duplicates collapse and the order you passed them stops mattering. Pass the whole list rather than splitting it yourself: a long one is batched for you. Prefer this over repeated `lookup_ip` calls when you already have the list, for example when triaging a log file. An address that fails carries its error in place of a result rather than failing the batch. Always read `coverage.note` before concluding anything from a field that is not in the result.

ips.description: The IPv4 or IPv6 addresses to classify.

name: lookup_ips

coverage.description: Which datasets this result covered. Read `note` before interpreting any absent field.

anyOf.description:
The union of every plan's answer. Only `ip` and `is_vpn` are guaranteed;
each remaining field is present when your plan includes it, and absent
otherwise. A client that must work across plans should treat an absent
flag as unknown rather than as `false`.

asn.description:
The autonomous system that announces the address. Free and paid plans.
Each field is present whenever the object is: `asn` is 0 and the rest
empty where no announcement covers the address.
The AS number, 0 when no announcement covers the address.

is_bogon.description: Present, and true, only for a private, reserved or otherwise non-routable address. Such an answer is given locally without calling the API, so every other flag in it is false by definition rather than by lookup. Absent from every served answer.

is_cdn.description: Whether the address belongs to a CDN. Paid plans.

is_dcproxy.description: Whether the address was seen in a datacenter proxy pool. Paid plans.

is_hosting.description: Whether the address belongs to a hosting or cloud provider. Paid plans.

is_mobproxy.description: Whether the address was seen in a mobile proxy pool. Paid plans.

is_pubproxy.description: Whether a public proxy, one anyone can connect through, listens on the address or sends its traffic out from it. Paid plans.

is_relay.description: Whether the address is privacy relay or enterprise web gateway egress, such as iCloud Private Relay or Zscaler. Free and paid plans.

is_resproxy.description: Whether the address was seen in a residential proxy pool. Paid plans.

is_tor.description: Whether the address is a Tor node. Free and paid plans.

is_vpn.description:
Whether the address is VPN infrastructure. Keys off presence in the
VPN dataset, so an unattributed range with no provider is still
`true`.

location.description:

database. Free and paid plans. Each field is present whenever the

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 code of the country's currency, where there is one.

currency_symbol.description: Symbol of the country's currency, where known.

flag_emoji.description: The country's flag, as an emoji.
